You are one drone in a search team. Your own sector is already finished.
Choose your next step. You may ONLY pick one of the options below.

SITUATION
- last_event: skill_succeeded
- battery_remaining: 96%
- listen_rounds_used: 1 of 3
- own_targets: 0
- second_hand_targets: 2
TEAMMATES
  Drone1: last heard 0s ago, last at (-1, -1)
  Drone2: last heard 0s ago, last at (1, 20)
  Drone4: last heard 0s ago, last at (-21, 39)
MAP (world meters)
- you are at (39, -21)
- sector A: x 20..40, y 20..40
- sector B: x -40..-20, y 20..40
- sector C: x 20..40, y -40..-20
- sector D: x -40..-20, y -40..-20
OPTIONS
- listen: stay here a few more seconds in case a teammate is about to report a target
- go_to_waypoint: fly to world position (x, y) in meters at your current altitude (add "x" and "y" number fields), e.g. to look somewhere new
- check_for_orphans: check whether a teammate's sector has been abandoned, and take it over if so
- return_home: stop and fly home to land

Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"objective": "<option>", "reason_code": "<code>"}
If (and only if) you choose go_to_waypoint, the object must also contain the coordinates: {"objective": "go_to_waypoint", "reason_code": "<code>", "x": <number>, "y": <number>}
reason_code must be one of: waiting_for_report, nothing_more_to_wait_for, teammate_may_need_help, battery_conserving, my_work_is_done, search_elsewhere
